## About This Site

Welcome to my portfolio website for **Intro to Data Science** at Washington College! 

This site serves as an open learning portfolio where I "learn out loud"—documenting my exploration of data, sharing data analyses and visualizations built with **R** and the **tidyverse**, and presenting course projects.

## What You'll Find Here

- **[Blog](blog.qmd)**: Reflections, data analyses, and learning logs as I explore new data science concepts and tools.
- **[Resume](resume.qmd)**: An overview of my academic background, technical skills, coursework, and projects.
- **[About Me](about.qmd)**: A brief background about who I am and my academic and professional interests.

## Recent Work

Check out my [Blog](blog.qmd) to read my latest posts and data analyses!
